Contrary to what some of my colleagues in Congress believe, that does not mean I get to pick and choose which Amendments and what rights are worth defending. The 2nd Amendment, your right as an American to bear arms, is equally as important as the entirety of the Bill of Rights.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">I have proudly stood against misguided gun control legislation that infringes upon your rights throughout my public service career. Page | U.S. Congressman Byron Donalds As a firm believer in limited federal government, I can not support the imposition of unaffordable and unconstitutional healthcare on the American people. As a nation with the most advanced medical practices and medicine in the modern world, the United States should have a prospering healthcare system, not be inundated with the failure of Obamacare. The Affordable Care Act is a ruse by the federal government to seize control over the health care and insurance industry, slowly leading the U.S. to a single-payer socialist system. <br /> <br /> By providing healthcare tax benefits and incentives to individuals, costs within the healthcare market will substantially decrease. I am a strong supporter of implementing the Commerce Clause, which allows for health insurance to be purchased and used across state lines. This would broaden provider access to millions of Americans and cut bureaucratic red-tape from those that are in need of immediate care. Page | U.S. Congressman Byron Donalds Southwest Florida’s waterways serve as the lifeblood of our community and our local economy. As your representative, you have my commitment that I will preserve and protect these precious waterways for generations to follow. I am in support of environmental research and projects that lead to the preservation of our waters. On the other hand, we cannot support legislation that will burden taxpayers and vital industries that create millions of good-paying jobs. Radical policies should not drive environmental policy. The solution should be simple; continue to be a responsible steward of the environment and support American energy jobs.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">The Central Everglades Restoration Plan is an excellent example of a commonsense, bipartisan solution that will maintain our water and conserve a vital part of our environment.</p>" /> Skip to Content Water Quality Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Southwest Florida’s waterways serve as the lifeblood of our community and our local economy. As your representative, you have my commitment that I will preserve and protect these precious waterways for generations to follow. On the other hand, we cannot support legislation that will burden taxpayers and vital industries that create millions of good-paying jobs. Radical policies should not drive environmental policy. The solution should be simple; continue to be a responsible steward of the environment and support American energy jobs. The Central Everglades Restoration Plan is an excellent example of a commonsense, bipartisan solution that will maintain our water and conserve a vital part of our environment.
